title: 结尾段的主题回应
goal: 选出保留原意的论点重述；判断结尾是否回应全文主题。

points.label: 选出保留原意的论点重述
判断结尾是否回应全文主题

sources.title: 大学英语六级（CET-6）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分本课的内容范围、知识点与练习规格

body.p: 结尾用新的说法重述正文已经支持的判断，对象、范围和条件都要保留。换词时立场不能变。照抄开头的原句，意思没变，但没有概括正文得出的认识。

body.box: Opening: A repair service is useful when spare parts remain available. Closing: Continued access to parts is therefore essential to the value of the service.

body.p: 结尾提出行动时，由谁做、对什么做，都要来自正文。正文没有论证过的新理由，不能放到结尾作为主要依据。

cards.title: 判断重述
rows: 重申一
保留评论只作参考、不代替判断的关系。
Opening: Reviews should inform choices, not determine them. Closing: Reviews are a source of evidence rather than a substitute for judgment.
重申二
保留有条件的支持，不改成普遍赞成。
Opening: Shared equipment is worthwhile for occasional users. Closing: Infrequent use makes access more valuable than individual ownership.
机械重复
照搬原句，没有概括正文增加的认识。
Repeated: Reviews should inform choices, not determine them. Revised: Comparing the reasons in reviews supports a more independent choice.
范围改变
只对部分人适用，不能改成人人需要。
Original: Occasional users benefit. Overstated: Every user should give up owning equipment.

cards.title: 适用条件
rows: 条件一
重提正文已说明的维护条件。
Opening: Community noticeboards need regular updates. Closing: Their usefulness depends on removing expired notices and keeping current ones visible.
条件二
保留正文已讨论的培训支持。
Opening: New software can help trained staff. Closing: Training is therefore a condition for realizing the software’s practical value.
新增条件
正文没有讨论的新条件，不能作为结尾的核心。
Body: Staff need training. Unsupported ending: The software is useful only in buildings with large windows.
条件强弱
can improve 是可能的作用，不能写成 guarantees。
Supported: Training can improve use. Overstated: Training guarantees flawless performance.

cards.title: 行动意义
rows: 意义一
行动对象来自正文的具体问题。
Opening: Unclear labels delay sorting. Closing: Replacing vague labels would give sorters a clearer basis for each decision.
意义二
行动者与正文建议一致。
Opening: Supervisors should explain changes to shifts. Closing: Clear explanations from supervisors can reduce uncertainty about the new arrangements.
空泛号召
没有写出由谁做、做什么，回应不了具体问题。
Vague: Everyone should work for a better future. Specific: Supervisors should publish the revised shift arrangements.
新理由
正文没有论证的效果，不在结尾才提出。
Body: Clear labels improve sorting. Unsupported ending: New labels will also increase local tourism.

body.box: A neighborhood tool cabinet should lend equipment that residents use only occasionally. Shared access avoids buying several copies of an item that spends most of its time unused. However, the cabinet needs a reliable return process so that the next borrower can find the item. Labels showing the return location and a record of current loans would support that process. The proposal therefore concerns occasional use with organized returns, rather than the replacement of every privately owned tool.

Which ending preserves the argument?
1. All privately owned tools should be replaced by a single cabinet.
2. Organized lending can make occasional equipment use more practical without requiring universal shared ownership.
3. The cabinet will also encourage residents to repair their own tools more often.
4. Residents should all work together to make the tool cabinet better.

body.p: 第二项保留了 occasional use 和 organized returns，并概括了它们的作用。第一项扩大了对象，第三项加入正文没有论证的新效果，第四项没有说具体做什么。

items.stem: Opening: Regular feedback can improve a draft when the writer has time to revise. Which restatement preserves the condition?
options: Feedback is most useful when revision remains possible before submission.
Feedback improves every draft even when no revision is possible.
Feedback is most useful when it is given after the draft has been submitted.
Revision is unnecessary when regular feedback has already been given.
items.why: when the writer has time to revise 对应第一项的 when revision remains possible，条件得到保留。

items.stem: Body: A museum map should show routes that avoid stairs. Which ending follows without adding a new reason?
options: Marking step-free routes will make every visitor’s walk through the museum much shorter.
Marking step-free routes can make the map more useful for visitors who need them.
Marking step-free routes shows that every visitor needs to avoid the stairs.
Marking step-free routes will persuade the museum to add more lifts and ramps.
items.why: routes that avoid stairs 就是 step-free routes。第二项只说地图对需要的游客更有用，没有加入正文以外的效果。

items.stem: Opening: Renting formal clothes can suit people who attend such events rarely. Which ending keeps the original scope?
options: For all events, renting is the only practical way to obtain suitable formal clothes.
For frequent events, owning formal clothes is never a practical option for anyone.
For infrequent events, renting may be a practical alternative to owning formal clothes.
For rare events, people should rent formal clothes instead of ever buying their own.
items.why: rarely 对应 infrequent，can 对应 may。第三项保留了原来的范围和语气。

items.stem: Body: Editors should explain corrections so contributors can avoid repeated mistakes. Which ending names the relevant action and actor?
options: Editors and contributors should all work harder to make every publication better.
Editors can reduce repeated mistakes by correcting every contributor’s work themselves.
Readers should make corrections without consulting the editors or contributors involved.
Editors can support future submissions by making the reasons for corrections explicit.
items.why: 第四项保留了行动者 Editors 和行动 explain corrections，support future submissions 对应 avoid repeated mistakes。第二项让编辑亲自改稿，改变了行动。

items.stem: Restate the claim that clear ownership makes a maintenance task easier to follow up.
items.why: can 表示可能的作用，不能换成 will always make。

items.stem: Retain the claim that limited trials provide evidence rather than certainty.
items.why: without guaranteeing 说明试验只提供证据，不保证结果。

items.stem: Close an argument about keeping a shared inventory current.
items.why: preserve the usefulness 概括了定期更新的作用，没有加入新的效果。

items.stem: End a discussion of advance notices by naming the action already proposed.
items.why: 提前通知要在出发之前，所以用 before。用 after 就改变了原来的建议。

items.stem: Opening: Flexible collection times can help customers whose work shifts vary. Which closing restates this without copying it?
options: Variable work schedules make some flexibility in collection arrangements worthwhile.
Every customer needs collection arrangements that remain completely unrestricted at all times.
Fixed collection arrangements are preferable for workers whose shifts regularly change.
Flexible collection times can help customers whose work shifts vary.
items.why: variable work schedules 对应 whose work shifts vary，第一项换了说法，范围不变。第四项照抄原句，不符合题干要求。

items.stem: Body: Rehearsal notes identify unclear scene changes; directors should revise those transitions. Which closing follows?
options: Using the notes to clarify transitions will also shorten every rehearsal and lower the cost of each performance.
Using the notes to clarify transitions gives the rehearsal a practical role in preparing the performance.
Everyone involved in the performance should keep working hard to make every rehearsal a success.
Replacing all scene changes with new scenes would make every rehearsal note unnecessary for directors.
items.why: 正文的建议是 revise those transitions。第二项只写用笔记理清转场；第一项加入的省时、省钱，正文没有论证。

items.stem: Opening: Short-term volunteering is valuable when duties match the time volunteers can offer. Which restatement retains the limit?
options: Limited volunteer time guarantees that every assigned duty will be completed successfully.
Volunteers should accept every duty regardless of how much time they can offer.
When duties suit their schedules, volunteers with limited time can make a useful contribution.
Longer volunteer commitments are always less useful than short assignments with fewer duties.
items.why: duties match the time 对应第三项的 duties suit their schedules，条件得到保留。第二项去掉了这个条件。

items.stem: Body: A lending desk should explain return dates and provide reminders to prevent avoidable delays. Which ending stays within that argument?
options: Clear dates and reminders will also increase the number of items the desk can lend each year.
Borrowers and staff should all try harder to make the lending desk work better for everyone.
Timely reminders should replace all return dates because reminders make clear agreements unnecessary for borrowers.
Clear dates and timely reminders give borrowers a practical basis for returning items as agreed.
items.why: 正文提出 explain return dates 和 provide reminders 两项做法。第四项两项都保留，并回应了按时归还。

items.stem: Restate a qualified claim about review periods without promising error-free decisions.
items.tail: that will affect several groups with different needs.
items.why: can give 表示可能的作用，不写成 always guarantees。before confirming 说明审查在决定之前。

items.stem: Restate the value of regular checks for equipment used only at special events.
items.tail: that must function reliably when the next event begins.
items.why: does not remove 表示偶尔使用的设备仍要定期检查。换成 removes，意思就反了。

items.stem: End a discussion of understandable instructions by naming the revision already supported in the body.
items.tail: who have not yet learned the organization’s internal terminology.
items.why: 结尾回应缩写造成的理解困难。晋升不是正文论证过的效果。

items.stem: Preserve maintenance as the condition for the value of a shared garden, as discussed in the body.
items.tail: that continues after the initial planting work has been completed.
items.why: depends on 把持续维护写成条件。is guaranteed by planting 与正文的论点不符。
